messages:
maya: heads-up: PR #46822 is ready for final review. It's the canary rollout for adaptive-batching. requesting runtime + infra + sec eyes for merge window this week. @chris @liam @olivia
chris: taking a look now. can you paste the canary schedule? :eyes:
maya: sure — planned canary:
```
canary: 2h total
phase 1: 15% traffic (30m)
phase 2: 50% traffic (60m)
phase 3: 100% (30m)
start window: Thu 09:00-11:00 PT
fallback: immediate rollback on latency > 20% or errors > 1%
```
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/46822
olivia: Sec: i can do a quick look for auth/KMS touchpoints. expecting config change to routing rules? include config diff pls.
maya: only routing weights + a small autoscaler tweak. no KMS. see diff snippet:
```diff
- max_batch_size: 64
+ max_batch_size: 128
```
liam: infra/sre: I can own rollout tomorrow morning if we lock the window. can we move to Fri 08:00 PT? less traffic.
maya: prefer Thu due to dependent release — but Fri 08:00 works as backup. who signs off on canary metrics? @sree?
sree: i'll own metrics & rollback criteria. will add alerting hooks to the dashboard and post thresholds in the PR.
chris: quick note: the change touches the eviction header path — can we run the e2e perf job before merge? /ci run e2e-perf-eviction
ci-bot: build passed; e2e-perf-eviction queued (job id 8842)
ci-bot: e2e-perf-eviction finished — 95th latency improvement 10% (no regressions)
maya: thanks — that looks good. @security/olivia any blockers from your side?
olivia: no blockers, one minor request: add comment about canary fallback in the config and author for audit. e.g., `canary_owner: liam`
maya: done in last commit.
liam: i'll be on-call during Fri 08:00 PT fallback window. backup: @chris
chris: noted. i'll be standby.
maya: any final approvals? @chris @liam @olivia @sree
chris: LGTM from runtime side. :thumbsup:
olivia: LGTM sec
liam: LGTM infra
sree: LGTM alerts
maya: thanks all — marking PR ready and scheduling canary for Thu 09:15 PT (primary) with Fri 08:00 PT as backup. will update PR description and slack channel before start. :shipit:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for PR #46822 at 2024-11-07T16:15:00Z (id: canary-46822)
maya: leaving this thread — ping me if anything changes.
